_comment: OPTIONAL overrides only. Every *.json file in this directory is auto-discovered and registered using its own top-level id/title/trigger/version — dropping a new demo file here is enough, no edit needed here. List an id below to override its delay_seconds, gate it behind a visibility_condition, disable it (enabled: false), or override title/trigger.
_visibility_conditions: Fixed allow-list evaluated server-side in demo_utils.lua (VISIBILITY_CONDITIONS) — JSON can't carry code. Currently supported: has_nanalyst. Add a new named check there before referencing it here.
